meta.head: 80b66e65 2026-10-15 Wire six reviewed Ossus fauna into habitat encounters
meta.method: Static reading of server source only; 'implemented' means code exists, not that it was tested. Code counts are git ls-files/git grep over each system's paths; TODO hits match TODO|FIXME|not implemented|unimplemented|not yet implemented. Commands from the command audit, stubs re-checked against the current headers.

biggest_gaps.label: Space (Jump to Lightspeed)
biggest_gaps.text: Only partly done and off by default upstream: 22 space combat commands have no script, component repair is a stub, and nothing has been flight-tested here. It is the largest system on the list.

biggest_gaps.label: Staff tools
biggest_gaps.text: 43 of 117 staff commands are still stubs, among them `/money`, `/planetWarp`, `/setRank`, `/grantTitle` and the spawner controls (the audit counted 45; `/spawnStatus` and `/showSpawnRegion` have since been made real locally). This affects running the server every day.

biggest_gaps.label: Player cities and Politician
biggest_gaps.text: Two of eight specialisations (Clone Lab, Entertainment District) cost 80,000 credits and do nothing; militia have no law-enforcement powers; `/cityWarn` and city guards are missing; the weekly cadence hides everything in short tests.

biggest_gaps.label: Battlefields
biggest_gaps.text: Markers only, no rules, and the three battlefield commands do nothing. This is the main pre-CU PvP content gap.

biggest_gaps.label: Image Designer
biggest_gaps.text: The server trusts the client on colour palettes and holo-emote purchases, and stat migration only works in the 4 salon templates. Otherwise the code is complete, not bare bones.

biggest_gaps.label: Bounty Hunter
biggest_gaps.text: No mission failure when someone else kills the target; `bounty_mission_level` is unread.

biggest_gaps.label: Creature Handler and pets
biggest_gaps.text: Owner priority. The code is complete, but the three CH skill mods (`private_creature_empathy`, `_training`, `_management`) are read nowhere, and pet balance and AI reliability have never been measured.

biggest_gaps.label: Gambling
biggest_gaps.text: Sabacc is commented out; only slot machines and roulette work.

biggest_gaps.label: Tutorial
biggest_gaps.text: Off by default although the zone is loaded (owner choice).

biggest_gaps.label: Stubs to check in game
biggest_gaps.text: `/harvesterHarvest`, `/harvesterMakeCrate`, `/harvesterTakeSurvey` and `/lootAll` are stubs that matter only if the pre-CU client sends them: check before building anything.
